title: THE OBSERVATORY × JET
headline: Make the innovation visible.
meta: For discussion with Simon and Chris
intro: You’re putting science and innovation to work on things that people need every day. Making heating more affordable, local food cheaper to produce for Jersey’s growers and the island’s infrastructure future-proofed, secure and resilient.

Now’s the time to show it working here in Jersey. In a way that fires up the imagination, carries the island along with your ambition and becomes a real exemplar for the people you want to partner with. All in your voice, demonstrated, measured, visible and ready to share with the world.

parts.text: You want people to see it, feel it and touch it, working.

p: The story that people can see and feel working. Solar glass, flexible solar panels, all trackable, controllable and producing heat. Harsh environments. Real-world local examples like Jersey Salt. Working in real time. Real evidence and new energy rooted into the experimental farm TB Davis gifted to the island in 1929.

blocks.h: ECONOMICS YOU CAN SEE AND FEEL
p: Give people things they can remember. A locally-grown pepper that costs them much less at the till. Real-time crop-cost calculators and grower stories. Power monitors, all visible, graphene-heated benches they can sit on, a launch powered by the energy you’ve stored.

blocks.h: AN ISLAND STORY FOR EVERY ISLAND
p: Islanders are known for facing challenges with bravery. Smart innovation rewards that, and at the crossroads, gives Jersey a path to go further. We’ll tell that story, from wartime hunger to food security, energy we can export, cost efficiencies for the agricultural sector and a new centre for technology innovation, all a tested and demonstrated blueprint for other island nations.

blocks.h: NOW’S THE TIME TO MAKE IT VISIBLE
p: Let’s open the doors. An inspired launch at the farm, powered by the energy it has stored. Positioning, brand and strategy to match the ambition and innovation. Show the measurable effects right now, with the vision to inspire locals, decision-makers, partners and investors.

parts.text: We’d like to join JET as a partner: part of the team, focused on what moves the business forward and responsible for getting the work done.
parts.sub: We’d become your always-on marketing department from creative to communications across everything JET needs to say and show.

items.t: A foundational audit of JET’s brand, tone and direction: what you say, how you say it, what you can prove and where the business is heading.
The audit gives everyone a shared starting point. From there, the work grows with JET, from the first priorities to the full programme.
Once the foundations are in, we stay on, looking after the brand, the content, the campaigns and the conversations, so JET can focus on the product.

items.h: ALL THE WAY TO THE LISTING
items.t: We’d like to be with you through the community raise and the listing on TISE. Anything connected to the raise is prepared with your advisers.

p: A clear account of what JET does, and where NeuValve, Alderney and the farm fit within it. Then an identity and voice with the industrial edge you asked for.
An organising idea for the business, with a mark of its own. We’d check existing use and protection before the design starts.
Turning working technology into something people can understand for themselves. Film and animation can explain what the eye can’t see, at the farm and well beyond it. Some early ideas to explore.

ideas.t: A bench warmed by graphene heating.
A display powered by the solar glass, showing power being generated, stored and used.

We can design the boards in the new tone and direction. The film and animation we make for the website and digital channels could also tell the story on site, through interactive screens, LED panels and a large screen that makes an impact the moment people arrive. All of it powered by JET’s own technology.
A crop-cost calculator, so people can see how energy shapes the price of their food.

ideas.k: Take the farm beyond the farm
ideas.t: A home for the farm on JET’s website, with film, trial updates and live readings through the growing season.
A launch powered by the farm’s stored energy, and pop-up dinners where the produce is the hero, an Arabian feast among them.

p: A website and core presentation built around proof. NeuValve’s investment story and launch. Support for infrastructure partners and the communities around them, with case studies as results come in.

parts.lead: A clear order of work, starting this week and built around the opening at the end of January.

rows.what: Findings in two weeks, to make time for the opening.

rows.name: BRAND
rows.what: Positioning, story and voice, ready for the opening.

rows.name: REBRAND

rows.name: ALWAYS ON

parts.note: The opening sets the pace to the end of January. Dates after it are set with you, around NeuValve’s launch and your plans for the raise.

parts.text: A proposal for how we could work together, for you to shape with us.
parts.sub: We don’t yet know your budget, so we’ve based this on our experience, the value we believe we can bring and the way we’d like to work with you as a partner. It can be dialled back to suit.

parts.label: Ready to start now, with a review together at the end of February.

p: We suggest £6,000 a month, inclusive of brand, strategy, positioning, the farm event and the website, with Ben leading JET’s creative direction and Sarah leading communications and marketing.
Our first milestone together is the January opening at Howard Davis Farm. We’ll agree what visitors need to see and understand, then build the story, website and on-site materials around it.

We’d begin with an initial three months, then review together to make sure we’re all happy and agree the priorities for the next phase. We firmly believe a partnership has to work for everyone, all of the time, and be fair to all. That’s how long-term relationships are built.

We’ll quote external production separately for your approval, including film makers, installation, and technology and AI systems partners. These are charged at cost, as is anything else we buy in for you, such as print, event hire and hosting.
The campaigns for each would be planned with your advisers once the timing is set.

parts.text: Fees would be paid monthly in advance and exclude GST where it applies. JET owns the finished work once it is paid for.
Talk it through this week, shape it together and start the audit on Monday 30 November.
